note: Observable-outcome acceptance for the v0.11 surface (05d). Each criterion runs a real command and passes only on exit 0. Budget discipline: quality evidence allows 60s per criterion and 120s total, so the criteria are the narrowest suites that still observe each contract item end-to-end. The exhaustive runs (full suite 391/391, audit 154/0, strict-profile/adverse/evidence/lock/state-fs runners, self-cycle, pilot, dogfood, package-check) are cited in brain/quality/bug-hunting-report.md and the release battery; they are not duplicated here because they exceed the per-check budget.

criteria.statement: R2: the shipped declarations are reachable through the real CLI (host list) and the cursor declaration is inspectable with its advertised status.
M1: the deterministic skill lint passes on every shipped skill file (71/71) with no model judge required.
M2/04c: the contract surface typechecks clean and the contracts directory is present and valid.

M2/04c: the shipped source typechecks clean with no emit (read-only observer; the perf budget is measured separately because `validate perf` rewrites a tracked generated view and would mutate the snapshot mid-capture).

R2: declarations carry the contract fields, bindings name real CLI argv, unsupported events are explicit and disjoint, and declarationProblems refuses verified-without-smoke / manual-guidance-with-events / shell interpolation.
R3c: the cursor adapter writes exactly one canonical managed entry, preserves foreign content, and refuses stray/duplicated/linked/ambiguous targets before writing.
R4: the evidence publisher refuses missing/stale bindings, overwrites, credentials, private paths, raw prompt blobs and reported-cost-as-billing.
R6: interrupted recovery and concurrent writers are handled honestly, and owner work is preserved rather than deleted.
